title: About BloodCare
description: BloodCare is a digital platform created to connect blood donors with patients who need blood.
details: The platform makes blood donor searching simple, organized and accessible for users.

title: Our Mission
description: Our mission is to make blood donation and blood searching easier for everyone.
details: We aim to connect suitable donors with patients and reduce the time required to find blood.

title: Our Vision
description: Our vision is to create a strong community where people come forward to donate blood and help save lives.
details: We want to use technology to create a reliable and accessible blood donation network.

title: Why Blood Donation Matters
description: Blood donation plays an important role in supporting patients during emergencies, surgeries and medical treatments.
details: Regular voluntary blood donation helps maintain blood availability and supports people in critical situations.

title: Helping Patients
description: BloodCare helps patients and their families search for suitable blood donors according to their requirements.
details: Users can search for potential donors and communicate with them when blood is required.

title: Supporting Donors
description: BloodCare provides a platform where willing donors can register and become part of the blood donation community.
details: Registered donors can provide their basic information and help patients who require their blood group.

title: Blood Groups
description: BloodCare supports major blood groups such as A+, A-, B+, B-, AB+, AB-, O+ and O-.
details: Correct blood group information helps users search for suitable donors more efficiently.

title: Emergency Support
description: BloodCare helps users search for potential donors when blood is urgently required.
details: The platform aims to make donor searching faster and easier during emergency situations.

title: Donor Registration
description: People willing to donate blood can register themselves and provide their basic donor information.
details: Registration helps create a useful donor database that can support patients when blood is needed.

title: Community
description: BloodCare brings donors, patients and communities together through a common blood donation platform.
details: A strong donor community can help improve blood availability and encourage voluntary donation.

title: Technology
description: BloodCare uses modern web technology to organize donor information and provide an easy-to-use platform.
details: The platform helps users access blood-related information in a simple and structured way.

title: Our Goal
description: Our goal is to make blood donation easier, faster and more accessible for everyone.
details: BloodCare aims to encourage more people to donate blood and help patients find suitable donors.
